name: Journey Through Time
quote: Behind the Welcome Centre, there is the 1 km self-guided Journey Through Time interpretive trail, which is very popular.
why: Short self-guided interpretive trail behind the Welcome Centre; page does not say loop or one way.

name: Yellowhead Mountain Trail
quote: This trail has 800 m elevation gain in 8.5 km and is recommended only for experienced, physically fit hikers.
why: Day hike to a sub-alpine meadow turnaround at 8.5 km (2 km viewpoint + 6.5 km), described as a return trip.

name: Mount Fitzwilliam Trail
quote: At 7.2 km, you reach the main campground, which is on the shore of Rockingham Creek.
why: Out-and-back to the main campground; the trail continues roughly to a second campground (11 km + 2.5 km), not counted here.

name: Moose River Route
quote: From the Moose River Route trailhead to the Berg Lake Campground is a 66 km hike.
why: Multi-day user-maintained route from Highway 16 via Jasper NP to Berg Lake; full loop length back via Berg Lake Trail not given.
